_note: Recorded simulate_aggregate_score responses used as the oracle for omega.aggregate. Formula confirmed: aggregate = SUM(score*alloc)/SUM(alloc); attribution = (score*alloc)/SUM(score*alloc); routes iff aggregate >= gate.

cases.teaches: Allocation tier IS the weight. Tier 0 contributes nothing.
(1*3 + 0*1) / (3+1) = 0.75 - the denominator is total allocation, not total contribution.
A tier-1 signal at 0.85 (15%) outweighs a tier-2 signal at 0.40 (14%). Score and weight trade off.

reportMembership._note: derive_strategy_rule_view response for the 7-column MR Stretch Panel in examples/build_section.py. Demonstrates that signals carry REPORT DEPENDENCIES: allocating weight to a NOT_IN_REPORT signal is wasted, because the report gives it nothing to read.
reportMembership.notableAbsence: bollinger_lower_touch is NOT_IN_REPORT - the panel carries no Bollinger column, so any allocation given to that signal is dead weight.
reportMembership.lesson: Always run derive_strategy_rule_view after designing a report and BEFORE assigning allocations. Report membership is not derivable from the column list by inspection.
